# R vs C ANALYSES 
```{r}
run_between_class_change_tests <- function(between_class_data,
                                          apns_ordered,
                                          feature_col,
                                          recovered_class_for,
                                          chronic_class_for,
                                          comparison_label = "Recovered vs Chronic",
                                          fdr_method = "fdr",
                                          q_digits = 3,
                                          export_feature_name = NULL,
                                          format_for_export = TRUE,
                                          format_num_fun = format_num) {

  feature_sym <- rlang::sym(feature_col)

  if (is.null(export_feature_name)) export_feature_name <- feature_col

  # --- t-tests per APNS × feature ---
  ttest_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(apns_ordered, function(apns) {

    rec_class <- recovered_class_for(apns)
    chr_class <- chronic_class_for(apns)

    between_class_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(.data[[apns]] %in% c(rec_class, chr_class)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Group = dplyr::case_when(
          .data[[apns]] == rec_class ~ "Recovered",
          .data[[apns]] == chr_class ~ "Chronic"
        ),
        Group = factor(Group, levels = c("Recovered", "Chronic")),
        APNS = apns
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(APNS, !!feature_sym) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Comparison = comparison_label,
        n_Recovered = sum(Group == "Recovered"),
        n_Chronic   = sum(Group == "Chronic"),
        Sample_Size = paste0("R=", n_Recovered, ", C=", n_Chronic),

        Recovered_Mean_EDvs6M_Change = mean(Change[Group == "Recovered"], na.rm = TRUE),
        Chronic_Mean_EDvs6M_Change   = mean(Change[Group == "Chronic"], na.rm = TRUE),

        Recovered_SD_EDvs6M_Change = sd(Change[Group == "Recovered"], na.rm = TRUE),
        Chronic_SD_EDvs6M_Change   = sd(Change[Group == "Chronic"], na.rm = TRUE),

        test = list(stats::t.test(Change ~ Group)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        t_stat   = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ unname(.x$statistic)),
        p_value  = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ unname(.x$p.value)),
        CI_lower = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ .x$conf.int[1]),
        CI_upper = purrr::map_dbl(test, ~ .x$conf.int[2]),

        # Signed contrast aligned with t-stat sign (Recovered − Chronic)
        SignedDiff_R_minus_C =
          Recovered_Mean_EDvs6M_Change - Chronic_Mean_EDvs6M_Change,

        # Magnitude clarity
        AbsMeanChange_Recovered = abs(Recovered_Mean_EDvs6M_Change),
        AbsMeanChange_Chronic   = abs(Chronic_Mean_EDvs6M_Change),
        AbsDiff_R_minus_C       = AbsMeanChange_Recovered - AbsMeanChange_Chronic,

        `Confidence Interval` = paste0(
          "[",
          formatC(CI_lower, format = "f", digits = q_digits),
          ", ",
          formatC(CI_upper, format = "f", digits = q_digits),
          "]"
        ),

        `Which group changed more?` = dplyr::case_when(
          AbsDiff_R_minus_C > 0 ~ "Greater EDvs6M Change in Recovered",
          AbsDiff_R_minus_C < 0 ~ "Greater EDvs6M Change in Chronic",
          TRUE ~ "No Difference"
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-test, -n_Recovered, -n_Chronic)
  })

  # --- FDR within APNS strata ---
  ttest_tbl <- ttest_tbl %>%
    dplyr::group_by(APNS) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = fdr_method)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(APNS, FDR, p_value)

  # --- clean export table ---
  export_tbl <- ttest_tbl %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      APNS,
      !!export_feature_name := !!feature_sym,
      `Sample size (pairs)` = Sample_Size,
      `T stat` = t_stat,
      `P value` = p_value,
      `FDR` = FDR,
      `Confidence interval (R − C)` = `Confidence Interval`,
      `Recovered Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = Recovered_Mean_EDvs6M_Change,
      `Chronic Avg Δ (6M − ED)` = Chronic_Mean_EDvs6M_Change,
      `Avg Δ (R − C)` = SignedDiff_R_minus_C,
      `Absolute Avg Δ (R − C)` = AbsDiff_R_minus_C,
      `Which group changed more?` = `Which group changed more?`
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = apns_ordered)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(APNS, `P value`)

  # format numeric columns only AFTER sorting (for export readability)
  if (isTRUE(format_for_export)) {
    export_tbl <- export_tbl %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), format_num_fun))
  }

  list(
    ttest_results = ttest_tbl,
    export_table = export_tbl
  )
}
```

## Cytokines
```{r}
cytokines <- c("IFN_gama", "IL_10", "IL_6", "IL_8", "TNF_alpha")

# create between class data 
between_class_cytokine_data <- cytokine_data %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(metadata_RNA_paired, by = c("PID", "Timepoint")) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(APNS_ordered), all_of(cytokines)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cytokines),
               names_to = "Cytokine",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = Value) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED), !is.na(M6)) %>%
  mutate(ED = as.numeric(ED),
         M6 = as.numeric(M6),
         Change = M6 - ED)

# run between classes analysis 
between_class_cytokine_results <- run_between_class_change_tests(
  between_class_data = between_class_cytokine_data,
  apns_ordered = APNS_ordered,
  feature_col = "Cytokine",
  recovered_class_for = recovered_class_for,
  chronic_class_for = chronic_class_for,
  export_feature_name = "Cytokine",
  format_for_export = TRUE)

between_class_cytokine_export <- between_class_cytokine_results$export_table

between_class_cytokine_export <- between_class_cytokine_export %>%
  dplyr::select(Cytokine, `Which group changed more?`,`Avg Δ (R − C)`,`Absolute Avg Δ (R − C)`, `P value`, FDR,`T stat`, `Confidence interval (R − C)`, `Recovered Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, `Chronic Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, APNS, `Sample size (pairs)`) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered))

```

### Export
```{r}
# .csv per APNS 
between_class_cytokine_export %>%
  split(.$APNS) %>%
  purrr::iwalk(function(df_apns, apns_name) {

    out_path <- file.path("Cytokines Analysis/Recovered vs Chronic/Results per APNS", paste0("Cytokines_Recovered_vs_Chronic_", apns_name, ".csv"))

    df_apns %>%
      dplyr::arrange(`P value`) %>%
      readr::write_excel_csv(out_path) 
  })


# excel workbook 

wb <- createWorkbook()

for (apns in APNS_ordered) {

  df_apns <- between_class_cytokine_export %>% dplyr::filter(APNS == apns)

  sheet_name <- substr(apns, 1, 31)

  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_name)

  df_write <- df_apns %>%
    dplyr::arrange(`P value`) 

  writeData(wb, sheet = sheet_name, x = df_write, withFilter = FALSE)

  header_style <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", halign = "center", valign = "center")
  body_style   <- createStyle(halign = "center", valign = "center")

  addStyle(wb, sheet_name, header_style,
           rows = 1,
           cols = 1:ncol(df_write),
           gridExpand = TRUE)

  addStyle(wb, sheet_name, body_style,
           rows = 2:(nrow(df_write) + 1),
           cols = 1:ncol(df_write),
           gridExpand = TRUE)

  setColWidths(wb, sheet_name, cols = 1:ncol(df_write), widths = "auto")

}


saveWorkbook(wb,file = file.path("Cytokines Analysis/Recovered vs Chronic/Summaries/All_APNS_Cytokines_Recovered_vs_Chronic.xlsx"),
  overwrite = TRUE)


```

## Cell Fractions
```{r}
cell_df <- cell_fractions %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(metadata_RNA_paired %>% dplyr::select(INVENTORY.CODE, PID),
            by = c("PID", "INVENTORY.CODE")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, INVENTORY.CODE, everything()) 

cell_types <- colnames(cell_df[, 6:ncol(cell_df)])


between_class_cell_data <- cell_df %>%
  left_join(metadata_RNA_paired, by = c("PID", "Timepoint")) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(APNS_ordered), all_of(cell_types)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cell_types),
               names_to = "CellType",
               values_to = "Proportion") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint,
              values_from = Proportion) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED), !is.na(M6)) %>%
  mutate(Change = M6 - ED)

between_class_cell_results <- run_between_class_change_tests(
  between_class_data = between_class_cell_data,
  apns_ordered = APNS_ordered,
  feature_col = "CellType",
  recovered_class_for = recovered_class_for,
  chronic_class_for = chronic_class_for,
  export_feature_name = "Cell Type",
  format_for_export = TRUE
)

between_class_cell_export <- between_class_cell_results$export_table

between_class_cell_export <- between_class_cell_export %>%
  dplyr::select(`Cell Type`, `Which group changed more?`,`Avg Δ (R − C)`,`Absolute Avg Δ (R − C)`, `P value`, FDR,`T stat`, `Confidence interval (R − C)`, `Recovered Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, `Chronic Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, APNS, `Sample size (pairs)`) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered))

cell_type_rename <- c(
  "NK.cells.activated"= "Activated NK cells",
  "Neutrophils" = "Neutrophils",
  "T.cells.regulatory..Tregs." = "Regulatory T cells",
  "T.cells.CD8" = "CD8+ T cells",
  "B.cells.naive" = "Naive B cells",
  "Macrophages.M2" = "M2 Macrophages",
  "T.cells.CD4.naive" = "Naive CD4+ T cells",
  "Mast.cells.resting"= "Resting Mast cells",
  "B.cells.memory" = "Memory B cells",
  "Plasma.cells" = "Plasma cells",
  "T.cells.CD4.memory.resting"= "Resting Memory CD4+ T cells",
  "Monocytes" = "Monocytes",
  "NK.cells.resting" = "Resting NK cells",
  "Dendritic.cells.activated" = "Activated Dendritic cells")

between_class_cell_export <- between_class_cell_export %>%
  dplyr::mutate(`Cell Type` = dplyr::recode(`Cell Type`, !!!cell_type_rename))

```

## Transcription Factors 
```{r}

tf_cols <- setdiff(names(TF_data), c("PID", "Timepoint", "APNS", "Group", "Class", "INVENTORY.CODE"))
length(tf_cols)

between_class_tf_data <- TF_data %>%
  left_join(metadata_RNA_paired, by = c("PID", "Timepoint")) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(APNS_ordered), all_of(tf_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(tf_cols),
    names_to = "TF",
    values_to = "Activity") %>%
  mutate(Activity = as.numeric(Activity)) %>%
  group_by(PID, TF, Timepoint, across(all_of(APNS_ordered))) %>%
  summarise(Activity = mean(Activity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = Activity) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED), !is.na(M6)) %>%
  mutate(Change = M6 - ED)


between_class_TF_results <- run_between_class_change_tests(
  between_class_data = between_class_tf_data,
  apns_ordered = APNS_ordered,
  feature_col = "TF",
  recovered_class_for = recovered_class_for,
  chronic_class_for = chronic_class_for,
  export_feature_name = "TF",
  format_for_export = TRUE
)

between_class_tf_export <- between_class_TF_results$export_table


between_class_tf_export <- between_class_tf_export %>%
  dplyr::select(TF, `Which group changed more?`,`Avg Δ (R − C)`,`Absolute Avg Δ (R − C)`, `P value`, FDR,`T stat`, `Confidence interval (R − C)`, `Recovered Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, `Chronic Avg Δ (6M − ED)`, APNS, `Sample size (pairs)`) %>%
  mutate(APNS = factor(APNS, levels = APNS_ordered))
```

# CRP 
```{r}
between_class_crp_data <- CRP_data %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  left_join(metadata_RNA_paired, by = c("PID", "Timepoint")) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("ED", "M6")) %>%
  dplyr::select(PID, Timepoint, all_of(APNS_ordered), CRP_log_adj) %>%
  mutate(CRP_log_adj = as.numeric(CRP_log_adj)) %>%
  group_by(PID, Timepoint, across(all_of(APNS_ordered))) %>%
  summarise(CRP = mean(CRP_log_adj, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Timepoint, values_from = CRP) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ED), !is.na(M6)) %>%
  mutate(
    Change = M6 - ED,
    CRP = "CRP_log_adj"
  )

between_class_CRP_results <- run_between_class_change_tests(
  between_class_data = between_class_crp_data,
  apns_ordered = APNS_ordered,
  feature_col = "CRP",
  recovered_class_for = recovered_class_for,
  chronic_class_for = chronic_class_for,
  export_feature_name = "CRP",
  format_for_export = TRUE
)

between_class_CRP_export <- between_class_CRP_results$export_table

write.csv(between_class_CRP_export, "CRP Analysis/Recovered vs Chronic/All_APNS_CRP_Recovered_vs_Chronic.csv")

```
